goal: Say hello and see what the assistant can help with.
Order 2 chicken burgers and a filter coffee to your room, and keep going until the assistant confirms the order has actually been placed.
Find out exactly what you ordered and what it costs.
Ask for extra towels for your room, and keep going until the assistant confirms it is being arranged.
Report that the AC in your room is not cooling, and keep going until the assistant confirms engineering has been told.
Check again what food you ordered - you want to be sure the food order is still correct after all that.
